text:
omar_partners: Quick sync — Stratify (SI + hardware) wants a co-sell. Need rules of engagement for lead intake, account mapping, and a joint announcement plan (marketplace + press). Target announce 2024-10-12. Quick ask: can we lock claim windows and ownership rules so there are no double-claims?

linda_pm: Do we have a current overlap report with Stratify's named accounts? I can pull it if folks agree on fields.

kevin_se: Proposal for mapping format (csv) — owner, preferred_reachout, claim_window_days. Example: 

```
account,redwood_owner,stratify_owner,claim_window_days,preferred_contact
Acme Corp,kevin_se,,14,acct-advocate@redwood.com
Beta Systems,,srina_stratify,14,partner-sr@stratify.com
Gamma LLC,kevin_se,sr_stratify,7,sales@gamma.com
```

tia_sales: Clarify: if Stratify originates a marketplace demo request, do we treat that as partner-originated (partner gets first outreach) or joint? Need SLA for response time.

nina_legal: Heads-up — we'll need a short MSA addendum for co-marketing/data sharing and explicit consent on marketplace lead forms. I can draft a 1-pager and sample checkbox copy.

omar_partners: Action items: Linda — overlap report; Kevin — finalize csv + small lookup script; Tia — draft 48h response playbook; Nina — legal addendum; Sam_ops — add metadata to marketplace listing for partner affiliation and joint_announce_date. Any objections?

sam_ops: No objections. I'll add fields to marketplace listing: `partner_affiliation`, `partner_slug`, `joint_announce_date`, `lead_origin`. ETA: Wed EOD. Also setting up webhook topic `marketplace.partner_leads`.

deploy-bot: Integration test for marketplace lead webhook passed (staging). CI#7890 green.

kevin_se: :thumbsup: I'll push the CSV template and a tiny script. Example command to push mapping: 

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/partner-claim -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -F "file=@mapping.csv"
```

linda_pm: Overlap report queued, will drop a spreadsheet in #partnerships tomorrow AM with delta by region.

tia_sales: Also proposing a 30m weekly triage with Stratify starting in two weeks (pre-launch cadence). Keeps claims fresh and avoids surprises.

omar_partners: Agree. I'll send the invite and add an agenda: mapping, playbook, legal review, announcement assets. Thanks all :rocket:
